purpose: Distribution and defined-risk payoff consistency; Q0 repricing diagnostics, not an alpha trading policy.
execution: One group. Buy ask, sell bid, exact snapshot and required displayed size. Mid is a diagnostic, never an assumed fill. Opening commission only, no extra exercise/settlement fee assumed. Hold intact to cash expiry. Quotes do not prove simultaneous fills.
risk: Expiry loss includes opening commission and declared extra slippage. Funding reserve = maximum expiry loss; illustrative research reserve, not a broker margin quote. No account sizing or recommendations.
decision: NO_TRADE_RESEARCH_ONLY: no validated physical P distribution. Positive Q0 residuals remain fit diagnostics.
sample: All 38 sessions in the existing evaluation archive, already inspected. Each candidate evaluated separately; overlapping candidates are not independent trades and are not summed into a portfolio.
